notes.title: Update Information Ver1.0.0.1(2021.12.10)
notes.notes:
■Bug Fix Notification
・A bug has been fixed in Monster Rancher 2 resulting from specific characters being including in the file/directory name of the save data file (specifically double-byte characters), causing issues with saving and loading
※Any save data that encountered this issue before this patch can no longer be utilized.
※Any save data slot that encountered this issue can be utilized after installing the latest patch and overwriting the save data slot.

notes.title: 【Bug Notification】
notes.notes:
An error may occur in Monster Rancher 2 in the game Monster Rancher 1 & 2 DX for Steam, which can cause issues with saving and loading. This issue appears to be caused by specific characters being included in the save data's directory name. (specifically double-byte characters).
We are currently researching the cause of the issue.
We apologize for any inconvenience this issue has caused.

12/10: This issue has been addressed in the Ver1.0.0.1 update.

notes.title: Monster Rancher is back, and it's on Steam
notes.notes: PlayStation-era cult classic Monster Rancher is on its way back, announced Koei Tecmo earlier this year, and it's now set for a release on Steam on December 8, 2021. The creature-collecting game has been ported to both PC and Nintendo Switch. The updated edition is a collection of the first two games in the series, and is called Monster Rancher 1 & 2 DX...
